source.description: Red coffee cup and notebook and pencil with philodendron plant on wooden table

prompt.zh: 移走红色陶瓷马克杯，换成一个装有冰柠檬水的透明玻璃杯，杯中可见两片柠檬。移走最右侧角落里的小盆栽。保持笔记本、桌面质感、拍摄角度及原有光照不变。玻璃杯必须投下逼真的阴影，并呈现出符合物理规律的折射效果。不要添加任何其他物体。
prompt.en: Remove the red ceramic mug and replace it with a transparent glass filled with iced lemon water and two visible lemon slices. Remove the small potted plant from the far-right corner. Keep the notebook, desk texture, camera angle and original lighting unchanged. The glass must cast a realistic shadow and show physically plausible refraction. Do not introduce any additional objects.
